authorization: Revised GRUT-C1, stacked on S1 draft PR #29
model: Original Candidate 1, leading flat scalar saddle and strict scalar one-loop order, original action, matching data and complete vacuum normalization
sign_convention: Delta = E_initial - E_asymptotic_final including strict pole rest mass for emission. Negative interval: protected. Positive interval: accessible. Zero-containing interval: inconclusive.

profiles.seed: Archived nodeless reference. For exact charges rescale seed radius by (N/Qref)^(1/3) as in the closure fork. Fixed-frequency stencils use refined parent.
profiles.stability: Matched radial grids h=.025 and .0125 out to rho=40. Count amplitude inertia below zero and at the positive gap. Check the amplitude Schur rank-one sign, phase gap and l=1 translation near zero with positive gap to next level. Check active-profile monotonicity and analytical angular ordering. Continuum stability remains conditional.

determinant.analytic: Complete vacuum normalization. Born-1 and Born-2 subtraction including reporter restored in MSbar with laboratory harmonics. Restore phase and translation logarithms with multiplicities 1 and 3.
determinant.fd_primary: O(h^2) Richardson from the two finest radial grids. For five derivative-only profiles use h=.025 and .0125, extrapolated.
determinant.archived_continuum_comparison: Original exact reference spline, n=8, edges [0,.25,1,3,10], ell<=40. Compare l>=2 independent extrapolated FD to archived continuum. Max sum of absolute per-ell differences .004.

absolute_allowance.method: Analytical HF and angular bounds on enclosed truncated spline plus empirical errors from radial, quadrature, origin/box/support, graphs and tree. No fitted tails.

paired_allowance.method: Form differences pointwise on common grids. Use analytical paired tails if difference envelopes pass. Otherwise use the sum of individual absolute tails.

chemical_potential.method: Sample K1 and Q at the mean of the emission endpoint frequencies and offsets {-h,-h/2,0,h/2,h} with fixed-frequency BVPs. Differentiate quartic K1 interpolant at two Gaussian nodes over the endpoint frequency interval. Add Omega Q0'(Omega) using tangent BVPs there. Audit against centered three-point stencils and a midpoint rule and calculate parent-endpoint curvature. Uses neither endpoint energy.
chemical_potential.method_agreement: Require overlapping emission intervals. Bound exact integrated omitted tails by analytical endpoint difference. Compare finite-cutoff stencil refinements and include their empirical error.

stopping.scope: Three exact-charge energies and local emission stencils only. Stop on controlling mathematical failure or budget. Preserve controls, failures and amendments. No parameter search or matching changes.
